name: ditto
description: Copy directory hierarchies, create and extract archives

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help for ditto

options.name: -h
options.description: Print full usage

options.name: -X
options.description: When copying one or more source directories, do not descend into directories that have a different device ID

options.name: -c
options.description: Create an archive at the destination path

options.name: -z
options.description: Create compressed CPIO archives, using gzip(1) compression

options.name: -j
options.description: Create compressed CPIO archives, using bzip2(1) compression

options.name: -v
options.description: Print a line of output to stderr for each source directory copied

options.name: -V
options.description: Print a line of output to stderr for every file, symbolic link, and device copied

options.name: -x
options.description: Extract the archives given as source arguments

options.name: -k
options.description: Create or extract from a PKZip archive instead of the default CPIO

options.name: --keepParent
options.description: When creating an archive, embed the parent directory name src in dst_archive

options.name: --arch
options.description: Thin Universal binaries to the specified architecture.

options.name: --bom
options.description: Copy only files, links, devices, and directories that are present in the specified BOM

options.name: -rsrc
options.description: Preserve resource forks and HFS meta-data.

options.name: --norsrc
options.description: Do not preserve resource forks and HFS meta-data.  If both --norsrc and --rsrc are passed, whichever is passed last will take precedence.

options.name: --extattr
options.description: Preserve extended attributes (requires --rsrc). As of Mac OS X 10.5, --extattr is the default

options.name: --noextattr
options.description: Do not preserve extended attributes (requires --norsrc)

options.name: --qtn
options.description: Preserve quarantine information.  As of Mac OS X 10.5, --qtn is the default

options.name: --noqtn
options.description: Do not preserve quarantine information

options.name: --acl
options.description: Preserve Access Control Lists (ACLs).  As of Mac OS X 10.5, --acl is the default

options.name: --noacl
options.description: Do not preserve ACLs

options.name: --nocache
options.description: Do not perform copies using the Mac OS X Unified Buffer Cache.

options.name: --hfsCompression
options.description: When copying files or extracting content from an archive, if the destination is an HFS+ volume that supports compression, all the content will be compressed if…

options.name: --nohfsCompression
options.description: Do not compress files with HFS+ compression when copying or extracting content from an archive unless the content is already compressed with HFS+ compression.

options.name: --preserveHFSCompression
options.description: When copying files to an HFS+ volume that supports compression, ditto will preserve the compression of any source files that were using HFS+ compression.

options.name: --nopreserveHFSCompression
options.description: Do not preserve HFS+ compression when copying files that are already compressed with HFS+ compression. This is only supported on Mac OS X 10.6 or later

options.name: --sequesterRsrc
options.description: When creating a PKZip archive, preserve resource forks and HFS meta-data in the subdirectory __MACOSX.  PKZip extraction will automatically find these resources

options.name: --zlibCompressionLevel
options.description: Sets the compression level to use when creating a PKZip archive.

options.name: --password
options.description: When extracting a password-encrypted ZIP archive, you must specify --password to allow ditto to prompt for a password to use to extract the contents of the file…
